atom:entry.atom:title: Same Day ACH: $10 million limit
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists an increase of the Same Day ACH dollar limit to $10 million for 17 September 2027. Who: US treasury, payout and originating-bank teams. Effective: 2027-09-17. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: ACH credits: 9am availability
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Non-Same Day ACH credits must be available by 9am in the receiving bank’s local time on settlement date. Who: Receiving banks and payout teams. Effective: 2026-09-18. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/rules/funds-availability-requirements-non-same-day-credit-entries

atom:entry.atom:title: ACH: IAT definition changes
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists its revised definition of International ACH Transactions among the September changes. Who: ACH originators and compliance teams. Effective: 2026-09-18. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: ACH availability exceptions update
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists changes to funds-availability exceptions for Non-Same Day credit entries. Check the rule text before changing controls. Who: Receiving banks. Effective: 2026-09-18. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: IAT: optional date-of-birth field
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Nacha lists the optional date-of-birth field for IAT entries for 19 March 2027. Who: IAT originators, banks and service providers. Effective: 2027-03-19. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: ACH: register IAT contacts
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Registration of IAT contacts in the ACH Contact Registry is listed for 1 January 2027. Who: ACH participants handling international entries. Effective: 2027-01-01. Official source: https://www.nacha.org/content/summary-upcoming-rule-changes

atom:entry.atom:title: Reg II: proposal watch, not a new rate
atom:entry.atom:summary: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Federal Reserve proposal docket is the source to monitor. No final rate, litigation outcome or effective date is asserted in this preview. Who: US debit economics and regulatory teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.federalreserve.gov/apps/proposals/FR-0000-0095-01/details
